title: Fictional missing-child reassessment: actual engine inputs
scope: New demonstration fixture, separate from every earlier evaluation corpus. All people, relationships, observations, assessments, decisions and outcomes are authored fictional inputs. A fixed modeled clock makes replay deterministic; it is not an execution timestamp.
stage_labels: New reports enlarge the evidence pool
Human corrects separate assessment; engine checks impact
Simulated human review and separate footbridge decision

modes.linked: Registered D1 dependencies; mapped human assessment changes; engine requests review.
modes.editorial: Assessment bytes change only in an unmapped note; no mapped-value change and no request.
modes.missing_link: D1 imported via legacy_reason with declared refs but no registered edges; mapped correction generates no request and incomplete coverage remains.
